movie_title: What if the World turned to Gold? - The Gold Apocalypse
introduction: The Map of Evolution and other sciency posters, researched and designed with love, are now available

vocabulary.definition: the action of imploding or collapsing violently inwards
vocabulary.example: The implosion of the building was controlled to prevent damage to nearby structures.

vocabulary.definition: having, caused by, or relating to a speed greater than the speed of sound.
vocabulary.example: The jet flew at a supersonic speed, breaking the sound barrier.

vocabulary.definition: an ionized gas consisting of positive ions and free electrons in proportions resulting in more or less no overall electric charge
vocabulary.example: The sun is primarily composed of plasma.

vocabulary.definition: capable of being shaped or bent without breaking
vocabulary.example: Gold is a malleable metal that can be easily shaped into various forms.

vocabulary.definition: a very large ocean wave caused by an underwater earthquake or volcanic eruption
vocabulary.example: The coastal town was devastated by the massive tidal wave that hit without warning.

vocabulary.definition: to press together or pack into a smaller space; condense
vocabulary.example: The machine compresses the air before it is released as a powerful blast.
